bottleneck.description: Dominant US-domestic supplier of Switchblade loitering munitions and tactical small UAS to US Army/DoD, with battle-tested program-of-record status that creates real qualification switching friction.

dependency.key_customers: US Army, US Marine Corps, US Special Operations Command, Ukrainian Armed Forces (via FMS), allied NATO militaries
dependency.key_suppliers: Various US-domestic electronics/composites suppliers; BlueHalo (post-acquisition) for space/cyber/directed energy; production capacity recently doubled to 2,000 units/month

editorial.notes: Switchblade has a real program-of-record moat in US loitering munitions (UVision and IAI exist but lack US production/DoD qualification at equivalent scale), and BlueHalo acquisition extends franchise into space/cyber/DE. However, the broader tactical UAS and loitering munition market is increasingly contested by Anduril, Shield AI, Kratos, Teal/Red Cat and low-cost FPV alternatives — the bottleneck is qualification and DoD relationship, not technological uniqueness. MEDIUM reflects real but contestable switching friction in a growing competitive field.
